parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom TSL module. Each identifier is unique in a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module is queried.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the TSL model. If you do not specify this parameter, the last published TSL model is returned.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Product Details page of the IoT Platform console. You can also obtain the ProductKey by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-thing-model-extend-config-published --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --model-version v1.0.0 --function-block-id BatteryModule --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryThingModelExtendConfigPublished --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --ModelVersion 'v1.0.0' --FunctionBlockId BatteryModule --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
